text:
ryan: Hey team, first week! Quick question: I'm prototyping a semantic search demo. Should I use my sandbox key or the hosted key for bulk embedding runs? Also curious about batch-size guidance and if sandbox rate limits differ for embeddings vs completion calls.

maria-devex: welcome ryan :wave: Use sandbox for local dev & demos. Hosted keys are billable and intended for prod. Sandbox has smaller quotas and stricter concurrency limits. If you're doing heavy batch runs we usually ask folks to request a temporary bump.

ryan: got it. Any ballpark numbers? I'm planning ~10k short docs (~50 tokens each). Thinking of batching 250 per request.

olivia-ml: fwiw, on hosted we often do 512-1024 vectors per request depending on model & memory. For sandbox, keep batches <= 250 to avoid 429s. Also prefer embed-1b for cost; embed-4b gives slightly better quality but uses more units.

tariq-infra: add to that: use exponential backoff on 429s with jitter, and respect Retry-After header if present. If you hit persistent throttling after 2 retries, reduce batch size by ~2x. Also avoid too many concurrent requests from your machine; limit to 2-4 parallel workers on sandbox.

maria-devex: tip: to request a sandbox bump, DM me with the dataset size, model, and the time window. We can temporarily increase units for demos/tests. For longer runs we recommend provisioning an ephemeral hosted demo key.

ryan: thanks! One more: is streaming disabled on sandbox? I'm using streaming for chat elsewhere.

olivia-ml: sandbox disallows streaming endpoints in many accounts. For chat streaming tests use a hosted demo key.

onboarding-bot: Pro tip: include a short retry/backoff policy in your test script. Example minimal backoff: 

```python
import time, random

def backoff(attempt):
    wait = min(60, (2 ** attempt) + random.random())
    time.sleep(wait)
```

ryan: perfect, I'll reduce batches to ~200, add retry+jitter, and ping maria for a temporary bump if needed for the 10k run. Appreciate it! :smile:

maria-devex: happy to help — ping me when you have the numbers and timeframe and I'll file the bump.
